mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artifact_ledger ( artifact_id, run_id, session_id, request_id, trace_id, tool_invocation_id, tool_call_id, artifact_role, visibility, source_type, source_id, source_name, artifact_type, artifact_name, file_name, storage_type, storage_ref, storage_key, download_url, preview_url, content_summary, mime_type, size, file_size, file_hash, metadata_json, deleted, deleted_at, idempotency_key, ext_json, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{artifactId}, #{runId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{toolInvocationId}, #{toolCallId}, #{artifactRole}, #{visibility}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceName}, #{artifactType}, #{artifactName}, #{fileName}, #{storageType}, #{storageRef}, #{storageKey}, #{downloadUrl}, #{previewUrl}, #{contentSummary}, #{mimeType}, #{size}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{metadataJson}, #{deleted}, #{deletedAt}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{extJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE artifact_id = #{artifactId} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE storage_type = 'local_artifact_storage' AND storage_key IS NOT NULL AND storage_key != '' AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) AND LOWER(visibility) = 'visible' AND LOWER(artifact_role) = 'output' ORDER BY create_time ASC, artifact_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) AND (artifact_type IS NULL OR LOWER(artifact_type) NOT IN ('llm_response', 'tool_result')) AND (storage_type IS NULL OR LOWER(storage_type) != 'inline_summary') ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE run_id IN #{runId} AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) AND (artifact_type IS NULL OR LOWER(artifact_type) NOT IN ('llm_response', 'tool_result')) AND (storage_type IS NULL OR LOWER(storage_type) != 'inline_summary') ORDER BY create_time ASC, artifact_id ASC

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE run_id IN #{runId} AND (artifact_type IS NULL OR LOWER(artifact_type) NOT IN ('llm_response', 'tool_result')) AND (storage_type IS NULL OR LOWER(storage_type) != 'inline_summary') ORDER BY create_time ASC, artifact_id ASC

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE tool_invocation_id = #{toolInvocationId} AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) AND (artifact_type IS NULL OR LOWER(artifact_type) NOT IN ('llm_response', 'tool_result')) AND (storage_type IS NULL OR LOWER(storage_type) != 'inline_summary') ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM artifact_ledger WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND tool_call_id = #{toolCallId} AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) AND (artifact_type IS NULL OR LOWER(artifact_type) NOT IN ('llm_response', 'tool_result')) AND (storage_type IS NULL OR LOWER(storage_type) != 'inline_summary') ORDER BY create_time ASC
